definition.en: The Balance of Payments (BOP) is a systematic record of all economic transactions between the residents of a country and the rest of the world during a given period.
definition.hi: The Balance of Payments (BOP) is a systematic record of all economic transactions between the residents of a country and the rest of the world during a given period.

importanceInUpsc.en: BOP is a core component of the GS-3 syllabus, essential for understanding India's external sector stability and currency valuation. It frequently appears in Prelims regarding trade deficits and in Mains for analyzing macroeconomic policy responses.
importanceInUpsc.hi: BOP is a core component of the GS-3 syllabus, essential for understanding India's external sector stability and currency valuation. It frequently appears in Prelims regarding trade deficits and in Mains for analyzing macroeconomic policy responses.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the structure of Current and Capital accounts.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the structure of Current and Capital accounts.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of BOP imbalances on the Indian economy.
